scope: Read-only public Git tree metadata comparison; no new sensor data downloaded or inspected.
interpretation: The checked upstream main tree does not provide additional independent physical wells or changed Parquet files beyond the installed dataset. No claim about private or future releases.
method: Compared all recursive dataset/*.parquet paths and Git blob IDs with git ls-tree -r HEAD dataset in the installed clean 3W checkout; extracted WELL- followed by digits from file paths. GitHub API tree was not truncated.
